state_layout: X[0] || ... || X[31], each X[i] is a 4-bit nibble; bit 0 is the MSB of X[0] and bit 127 is the LSB of X[31]
round_semantics: For i=0..15, before permutation T[2i]=X[2i] and T[2i+1]=S(X[2i]) xor X[2i+1] xor K[(r-1) mod 2][i] xor RC(r,i). The next state satisfies Xnext[pi(j)]=T[j].
round_constant_semantics: RC0[r] is xored at i=1 and RC1[r] at i=3; all other RC(r,i) are zero. Round index r starts at 1, while the arrays below start at index 0.
required_semantics: Return every output bit whose XOR sum over the full cube is zero for every fixed master key. A sound monomial-prediction SAT encoding may certify a bit by UNSAT of the corresponding output-monomial query.
